title: Canonical Letter
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Documenta Catholica Omnia Canones GR (typed print); PG 10.1019–
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Canonical Letter: his rulings for a fellow bishop after the Gothic raids on Pontus, on captives who ate the raiders' food, women taken by force, Christians who looted or joined the invaders, and the stages of penance. A fresh English translation of all eleven canons.
era_note: Written amid Gothic raids in Pontus under Gallienus. Canon 11, on the stages of penance, is probably a later addition to the letter.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF); this is a fresh English translation of all eleven canons from the Greek.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation from the Greek of the Documenta Catholica Omnia Canones GR typed print, read from the page images (pages 1–3) and matched against its text layer. Vossius' Latin notes (1684) were checked where they bear on the wording; they hold no running Greek of the canons, and PG 10 was not in hand. ANF was consulted only as a sense check.
